svg.title: Albright knot — how to tie it
svg.desc: Albright knot, in 5 steps. Form a loop in the heavier line. Pass the lighter line through the loop and wrap it back over both legs, ten turns, working toward the loop's end. Feed the tag back out through the loop the same side it entered. Wet, seat the wraps down the loop, then pull both standing lines. Trim both tags.
